consequence.statement: Customization is optional; the default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`) is created automatically and only affects cluster resource efficiency.

assertion.statement: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`); operators may optionally replace it with a targeted MRAP before installing v2 providers.
